correctness.rationale: Unitary dilation reduces lattice to (1,1/2), where the Zak/Parseval frame multiplier is a sum of squared even-odd parity fibers. Simultaneous zeros imply W=H_E O-H_O E=0; absolutely convergent grouping gives W=C_lambda e^{2pi i omega} Z(exp(-2pi lambda t²))(x-1/2,2omega+1/2). Jacobi product shows C_lambda>0 at every lambda>0 and the Gaussian Zak transform has one zero per fundamental torus. At the resulting two-parity symmetry fibers H_E=H_O=0, while E,O nonzero, so a common zero exists only for shift delta=0, equivalent to B=0 for A≠0. Pure Gaussian A=0 is a frame by unique Gaussian Zak zero and half-frequency separation. Independent numeric Wronskian evaluations across multiple widths confirmed but cannot prove global zero geometry.

The parity Wronskian gives a structural mechanism and complements known frame-set arithmetic boundaries.
